title: Heal
prompt: The starter has a member `health` at 50 and a `take_damage` helper. The robot needs the opposite too, a `heal` helper, and health_after_heal reports health after healing 20: 70.
hints: heal adds an amount to health, the mirror of take_damage; health_after_heal calls heal(20) and returns health.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.
